string-array.name: ex_h9_1_steps
string-array.item: Drop into a squat and explode upward into a jump.
Land softly straight into your next squat.

resources.string: Fires up lateral glutes and balance.
Standing straight up and losing hip hinge.

string-array.name: ex_h9_2_steps
string-array.item: Bound laterally from side to side like a speed skater.
Tap the trailing foot lightly behind the standing leg.

string-array.name: ex_h9_3_steps
string-array.item: Set a high plank with feet wider than shoulder-width.
Tap opposite shoulders alternately without swaying your hips.

resources.string: Burns high calories quietly without jumping.

string-array.name: ex_h10_1_steps
string-array.item: Step out sideways into a squat, then reach arms skyward as you stand.
Repeat on the opposite side.

resources.string: Warms up hamstrings and shoulders together.

string-array.name: ex_h10_2_steps
string-array.item: Hinge down from standing, hands to floor, and walk hands forward into plank.
Walk hands back to feet and stand.

resources.string: Short crisp exhale with every punch.

string-array.name: ex_h10_3_steps
string-array.item: Take a boxing guard and throw brisk jabs, crosses, and hooks.
Stay light bouncing on your feet.

resources.string: Keep lower back close to the wall.
Wrists and elbows lifting off the wall.

string-array.name: ex_h11_1_steps
string-array.item: Press back, glutes, and head gently against a wall.
Slide arms from a W shape up into a Y keeping contact with the wall.

resources.string: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades.

string-array.name: ex_h11_2_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down and lift arms successively in Y, T, and W shapes off the floor.

resources.string: Kicking the leg too high and arching the lower back.

string-array.name: ex_h11_3_steps
string-array.item: From all fours, extend right arm forward and left leg straight back.
Hold 2 seconds and switch sides.

resources.string: Calms the nervous system with slow breaths.
Tensing the shoulders instead of relaxing.

string-array.name: ex_h12_1_steps
string-array.item: Sit hips back onto your heels, reach arms forward, and rest forehead on the mat.
Feel your back lengthen with each breath.

resources.string: Forcing a painful knee bend angle.

string-array.name: ex_h12_2_steps
string-array.item: Bend one leg in front of you and extend the other straight behind.
Relax your torso gently forward.

resources.string: Ease into the stretch as you exhale.
Forcing or hyperextending the knee joint.

string-array.name: ex_h12_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back, raise one leg upward, and gently pull toward you with a towel.

resources.string: The secret to equipment-free leg growth.
Exhale on the final stand up.

string-array.name: ex_hp1_1_steps
string-array.item: Squat all the way down, rise halfway, sink back to the bottom, then stand all the way up.

resources.string: Top stepping stone toward one-arm push-ups.

string-array.name: ex_hp1_2_steps
string-array.item: Set hands wide, straighten one arm out while lowering your chest toward the other hand.

resources.string: Best bodyweight pull for home back thickness!
Letting hips sag toward the floor.

string-array.name: ex_hp1_3_steps
string-array.item: Lie beneath a sturdy table, grip the edge, and pull your chest cleanly toward it.

resources.string: Combines explosive power with peak heart rate.
Landing stiffly without absorbing through knees.

string-array.name: ex_hp2_1_steps
string-array.item: Perform a burpee and leap forward instead of straight up.

resources.string: Banging the back knee onto the floor.

string-array.name: ex_hp2_2_steps
string-array.item: Jump out of a lunge and switch legs cleanly in mid-air.

resources.string: Alternate your leading arm each set.
Swaying hips wildly side to side.

string-array.name: ex_hp2_3_steps
string-array.item: Transition from forearm plank up onto palms one arm at a time, then back down.

string-array.name: ex_hp3_1_steps
string-array.item: Turn fingers out/back, lean shoulders well ahead of your hands, and perform push-ups.

resources.string: Push shoulders firmly away from ears.

string-array.name: ex_hp3_2_steps
string-array.item: Sit with palms pressed beside hips, push shoulders down, and tuck knees up into the air.

resources.string: Continuing explosive reps when already fatigued.

string-array.name: ex_hp3_3_steps
string-array.item: Drive explosively from the bottom so hands clear the floor (optional clap).

resources.string: Slightly bend knees if your lower back lifts.
Arching lower back off the floor.

string-array.name: ex_hp4_1_steps
string-array.item: Lie supine and glue your lower back firmly into the floor.
Lift shoulder blades and straight legs slightly into a shallow banana shape.

resources.string: Form a crisp V shape at the top.
Dropping heavily back onto the floor.

string-array.name: ex_hp4_2_steps
string-array.item: From a flat lie, snap hands and straight legs up together at the top.

resources.string: One of the elite abdominal strength movements.
Bending at the hips instead of staying rigid.

string-array.name: ex_hp4_3_steps
string-array.item: Anchor hands on a heavy sofa or pole behind your head, raise your body vertical onto your shoulders, and lower straight as a board.
